maxItems.title: Max tenders to extract
maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of active tenders (licitaciones) returned this run. The source only covers active/open tenders (Licitaciones) - awarded or historical tenders are out of scope for this actor.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Required: webecommerce.cba.gov.ar blocks non-residential-Argentina traffic from the cloud (verified live - ConnectTimeoutError from Apify's datacenter IPs). Defaults to Residential + Argentina; do not switch to datacenter.
